title: 17968 - 17968/P1560/005472
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Rev Limiter Removed, Kontrol edin: to see if ECM has been 'Tuned'.
Engine Speed too fast due to a mis-shift or the "Money-Shift".
technicalNotes: This DTC indicates that the Engine Speed has passed the recommended safe RPM limit, which may potentially cause severe engine damage.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
